Example Corp Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
August 1, 2026

Safe Harbor Statement
This call contains forward-looking statements. Actual results may differ. Not investment advice.

Prepared Remarks

CEO Jane Smith:
Good afternoon everyone. We are pleased with a solid quarter. Revenue was $1,250 million, up 12% year over year. Gross margin reached 48.5%. We remain confident in our long-term position.

CFO John Lee:
EPS was $1.42. Operating margin was 22%. For the full year, our guidance is revenue of $5.1 billion. We expect free cash flow near $800 million.

Question-and-Answer Session

Operator: Our first question comes from Alice Chen with North Peak Research.

Q - Alice Chen, North Peak Research:
Can you break down the revenue growth drivers and any commentary on China demand?

A - Jane Smith:
About 60% of the growth came from cloud subscriptions. China demand was stable but we remain cautious on near-term visibility.

Operator: Next question from Bob Ruiz with Harbor Capital.

Q - Bob Ruiz, Harbor Capital:
What is the outlook for gross margin in the second half?

A - John Lee:
We expect gross margin around 49% if mix stays favorable. That is guidance, not a guarantee.

Operator: That concludes our Q&A. Thank you.
